_note: Marketing metadata for the static per-view pages and their OG cards. Written for sharing, which is why these titles are not the navigation labels. build.mjs reads this to emit one page per view; tools/og.py reads it to draw the cards.

views.title: The whole idea in two minutes
views.desc: No formulas. One everyday comparison, the single idea the EVERYTHING Protocol is built on, and the six people you are about to follow.

views.title: One reserve, three markets
views.desc: Everywhere else an AMM, a money market and a leverage venue each hold their own capital. Here one contract holds one reserve that does all three jobs at once.

views.title: Where the price comes from
views.desc: No oracle, no committee. The price falls out of how much of each token the pool is holding, and this is where impermanent loss comes from.

views.title: A swap does not go to the curve first
views.desc: His input is offered, best price first, to every resting order his trade crosses. He gets 1.3 % more for doing nothing at all.

views.title: The safest seat in the protocol
views.desc: She rests a limit order and declines the lend flag. Filled at her exact price, zero slippage, and nothing can ever hold up her exit.

views.title: Yield, bought with your freedom to leave
views.og: Nadia's money works while it waits
views.desc: Her capital earns interest while it waits for a price. What that yield costs is not loss risk. It is the right to cancel whenever she wants.

views.title: Your liquidation price moves on its own
views.og: David gets liquidated by the clock
views.desc: He picks the price at which he accepts to be wiped out. What nobody mentions is that the number drifts against him as interest accrues.

views.title: Leverage with no cap and no stop-loss
views.desc: Borrow, swap, post, repeat, in one transaction. The maximum is written nowhere: it falls out of the penalty, the buffer and the swap cost.

views.title: The LPs are the insurance fund
views.og: Farid is the one who pays
views.desc: Two income streams on one deposit, and the whole loss waterfall lands on him. He cannot even leave while it is happening.

views.title: A band, not an oracle
views.desc: Two markers bracket the price and decay toward it. An attacker who pushes the price pays twice and only widens the margin working against them.

views.title: Nobody is paid to liquidate
views.desc: The cascade runs inside every operation, closes a whole price rung in one step, and defers what the junior tranche cannot absorb.

views.title: Six tests, one badge
views.desc: Six tests, forty-nine questions. Pass every one at 75 % and the badge unlocks, signed to your address.

views.title: Which of the six are you?
views.og: Which of the six are you?
views.desc: Four questions, no wallet, thirty seconds. Find out whether you are Bob, Alice, Nadia, David, Elena or Farid, and read the view that is about you.
